segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin generally report the cream absorbs quickly, controls shine, and leaves a glassy or glowy finish without greasiness, though one oily-skin teen felt this line runs too drying for her.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin are split: several say it finally hydrated dry patches within days, while others describe it as severely drying or even causing chemical burn and worsened dryness.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers describe it as gentle and non-drying while keeping the T-zone controlled, though one combination-skin reviewer in a dry climate found it drying.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are divided: some (including one with eczema) say it is surprisingly non-irritating and breakout-free, while others report it broke them out or left their skin too dry to continue.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s or going through menopause report it is hydrating without heaviness, helps with oiliness and occasional spots, though one uses a richer product at night for extra moisture.
segments.normal: One reviewer with normal skin says the line leaves her face feeling fresh and requires only infrequent use.

concerns.aging: The few reviewers who mention their age or menopause report the cream feels adequately hydrating for mature skin, with one supplementing with a heavier product at night.
concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers say the cream hydrates without greasiness and resolves dryness within days; a substantial minority instead report it caused severe dryness, tightness, or chemical burn.
concerns.redness: Reviewers report reduced redness and calmer-looking skin within days to weeks of use; no dissent on this point was found.
concerns.barrier: Sensitive and eczema-prone reviewers mostly report no irritation or new breakouts, but a few describe burning, swelling, or itching, including one severe eye-contact reaction.
concerns.spots: Reviewers with occasional spots or hormonal breakouts report individual pimples shrinking overnight or clearing within a week; one reviewer says it did not noticeably help with acne.
concerns.blemishes: Most acne-prone reviewers report fewer breakouts, less congestion, and clearer skin over weeks; a minority report the opposite, with worse or new breakouts including cystic-type reactions after starting.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers consistently report reduced shine and a non-greasy, matte-to-glowy finish with no reports of increased oiliness.
